description: The head and long neck of a dragon, seen close in profile facing left. Its hide is a fine mesh of black and silver-grey scales, with short pale spikes down the neck, two swept-back horns and a narrow snout. A cold cyan eye glints above open jaws showing white teeth and a long forked red tongue. Behind the neck rise huge wings, dark grey ribs stretched with checkered grey and violet skin, framing the head on both sides. The background is a flat, deep magenta-purple. The mood is cold and menacing, lit evenly with bright highlights on the scales. Frame 1: the tongue hangs low out of the jaws, held long. Frame 2: the tongue curls up toward the teeth. Frame 3: the tongue flicks forward. Frame 4: the tongue droops low again, held. Frame 5: the tongue lifts and twists. Frame 6: the tongue snakes out further, held. Frame 7: the tongue curls back, held before the loop restarts. The loop reads as a slow, lazy, serpent-like tasting of the air while the head stays still.
title: Black dragon flicking its tongue
